steps.name: Open the world list from Minecraft's main menu
Wait for the world list to finish rendering
Tap Create new world
Wait for the Create From template chooser
Tap Create new world from scratch
Wait for the Create New World form
Focus the test world name field
Append the unique test world marker
Wait after naming the test world
Toggle Creative game mode
Wait for the Creative-mode achievements notice
Scroll the sidebar down to reveal Cheats, Advanced, Resource packs, and Behavior packs
Finish scrolling the sidebar down to reveal the pack and cheat tabs
Wait for the scrolled sidebar
Open the Cheats tab
Wait for the Cheats form
Activate Cheats (needed for the fresh-world /tp and /setblock commands)
Wait for Cheats to enable
Open the Advanced tab for the World seed field
Wait for the Advanced form
Focus the World seed field
Wait for the seed keyboard
Type the deterministic world seed
Wait after dismissing the seed keyboard
Scroll the sidebar back up toward Create
Finish scrolling the sidebar back up toward Create
Wait for the restored sidebar
Tap CREATE
Wait for the achievements-disabled dialog
Confirm Create anyway
Wait for the fresh world to finish loading
Open the pause menu to activate packs
Wait for the pause menu
Save and quit to the world list
Wait for the world list
Open the craftberry test world edit screen
Wait for craftberry test world settings
Scroll the settings sidebar down to reveal Resource packs and Behavior packs
Wait for the pack controls
Open Behavior Packs
Wait for Behavior Packs to finish rendering
Confirm the Behavior Packs screen is open
Open Available Behavior Packs
Wait for available behavior packs
Confirm the imported behavior pack is available
Activate the imported behavior pack
Wait for behavior pack activation
Accept the add-on stacking modal when shown
Confirm the add-on stacking notice
Wait for behavior and dependent resource activation
Open Active Behavior Packs
Wait for active behavior packs
Confirm the behavior pack is active
Open Resource Packs after behavior activation
Wait for Resource Packs after behavior activation
Open Active Resource Packs
Wait for active resource packs
Confirm the dependent resource pack is active
Scroll the settings sidebar back toward Play
Finish scrolling the settings sidebar back to Play
Wait for the world Play button
Launch the craftberry test world locally in creative mode
Wait for the craftberry test world to finish loading
Teleport to the deterministic crafting-table staging position
Wait after teleporting
Clear the reused player's inventory before crafting
Wait after clearing the player's inventory
Place a crafting table directly in front of the staged position
Wait after placing the crafting table
Open the crafting table directly in front of the player
Wait for the crafting table interface
Confirm the crafting table interface is open
